# Capital Business Advisors, Inc.

Capital Business Advisors, Inc. is a full-service business brokerage firm specializing in the confidential sale and acquisition of privately-owned businesses located throughout upstate New York and southwestern New England.

Our mission is to facilitate “win-win” transfers of business ownership between buyers and sellers. We have built a solid reputation through our ability of matching the right business with the right buyer. As intermediaries, we are in direct and continual contact with a large pool of qualified individuals and companies who have the resources and motivation necessary to buy or sell successful, established businesses.

At Capital Business Advisors, we measure our success in very simple terms…. by getting you results. Contact us today to learn more about how we can help you achieve your business sale or acquisition goals.
